title: Six decisions before anyone spoke: setting, role, and consent

objectives.statement: Trace a named fact in a fictional clinical record back to the specific setup decision that made it available, and state what the record would have contained instead under a stated alternative arrangement.

Distinguish a negotiated and revisable agreement from a recorded permission, state what has to be disclosed for the agreement to mean anything including the limits the person does not control, and identify the point at which such an agreement changed.

Classify who holds which role in a described encounter and decide which acts a person in a non-clinical role may and may not perform, justifying each decision from the act and the person it lands on instead of from the subject matter.

Prepare an accessible simulated encounter by settling its place and privacy, who is present and on what basis, each person's role and the purpose, the time available, the record and who reads it, and the communication arrangements, and state the resulting agreement and its limits.
